extraction.Name: Louis Primeaux
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: All sold by allottee to satisfy mortgage.
extraction.Buyer: purchased by Ed Barclay, of Marland, Okla.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: after paying mortgage and debts, I received $3000.00
extraction.NOTES: Health good; wife and four minor children dependent upon him for support; $10,000.00 was the consideration for the land, but after paying mortgage and debts, received $3000.00; patent was receipted for by purchaser; document notarized November 20, 1928, before notary in Kay County, Oklahoma; notary commission expires Aug. 3, 1931; No funds stated under financial condition.
